newsitem.title: USA: Georgia revenues up 3.4 percent in February.
newsitem.headline: Georgia revenues up 3.4 percent in February.

text.p: Georgia revenues for February totalled $902.78 millioin, in increase of 3.4 percent or $30 million over February of last year, acting Revenue Commissioner Jerry Jackson said Thursday.

Collections for the year to date totalled $6.86 bilion, up 6.8 percent or $436.8 million over the same period last year. Sales and usage tax revenues were up 3.3 percent for the year to date, while individual income tax revenues rose by 12 percent and corporate income tax revenues rose by 0.6 percent for the year to date.
The data are for the year that began July 1.
